# Trigge Solutions

> Software development company based in Pennsylvania, United States, building
> custom websites, web applications, e-commerce platforms and internal tools for
> businesses across all 50 U.S. states and Canada. Every project starts with a
> free consultation and a fixed written quote, and the client owns the code.

- Website: https://triggesolutions.com
- Contact: trigge.info@gmail.com | https://triggesolutions.com/contact
- Based in: Pennsylvania, USA
- Serves: United States (all 50 states) and Canada, in every time zone
- Languages: English

## Services

- **Web Development** — Marketing sites and landing pages on modern frameworks,
  optimized for speed, search engines and conversion.
- **Web Applications** — Dashboards, internal tools and customer portals designed
  around the way a business actually works, with role-based access, real-time
  data, reporting and cloud deployment.
- **E-Commerce** — Storefronts from product catalog to checkout and payments,
  with inventory management, order automation and multi-language support.
- **UI/UX Design** — Research, wireframes and interface design, including design
  systems, prototypes, accessibility (WCAG) and mobile-first layouts.
- **Integrations & APIs** — Connecting websites and platforms with ERP, CRM,
  payment and logistics systems over REST and GraphQL, so data flows without
  manual work.
- **Maintenance & Support** — Uptime monitoring, security updates, performance
  tuning and priority response after launch.

## Technology

Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, AWS,
Vercel, Docker, Stripe, Figma.

## How projects run

1. **Discovery** — A free consultation to understand goals, users and
   constraints, then agree on scope and timeline.
2. **Design** — Wireframes and interface design, reviewed with the client before
   production code is written.
3. **Development** — Short iterations with a live staging link, open from week
   one, plus weekly demos and a shared project board.
4. **Launch & Support** — Testing, deployment and handover, then monitoring,
   updates and continuous improvement.

## Common questions

**How long does a project take?** A marketing website usually takes 3–5 weeks. A
custom web application typically runs 8–16 weeks depending on scope. A written
timeline with milestones follows the discovery call.

**How much does it cost?** Every project is quoted individually after a free
consultation, as a fixed written quote with a clear breakdown and no hidden
costs. Typical project budgets range from under $5,000 to $40,000 and above.

**Who owns the code?** The client does. On final delivery they receive the source
code, the repository and all related accounts and documentation.

**Do you work remotely across the U.S. and Canada?** Yes. Work runs through
regular calls, a shared project board and a live staging link, in every time zone
from Newfoundland to Hawaii.

**Can you take over an existing project?** Yes. Existing codebases are audited,
fixed and extended, starting with a technical review of what is worth keeping.

**What happens after launch?** Maintenance plans cover monitoring, security
updates, backups and ongoing improvements; support is also available on demand.
